simple_review: one SG entry, 8B alignment, 32bit mask, BTT16; one pending descriptor becomes active; no implicit error reset
controller_reset_scope: both MM2S and S2MM; peer reserved with no RX descriptor; sync both IRQ/tasklets and descriptor queues before reuse
error_policy: ERR_IRQ only invokes GP STOP first; normal IOC does not; DMA_ERROR reported to client
quiescence: both HALTED / RUNSTOP+RESET clear / all descriptor queues empty; both IRQ+tasklets synchronized; post-reset stability recheck after 10ms; hard-PS outstanding bus closure still requires board evidence
unload_policy: self reference while DMA buffer retained; explicit successful RELEASE only then drops pin; failure quarantine never frees/reuses/reopens
